rules.trapName: Failure to Provide 30-to-60 Day Written Notice
rules.statuteSummary: Any business that offers a contract with an automatic renewal clause for a term of 12 months or more must provide written notice to the consumer 30 to 60 days before the cancellation deadline or renewal date.
negativeExceptions: written notice will be sent 30 days prior
rules.disputeTemplate: Under 815 ILCS 601/10(b), Illinois requires written disclosure 30 to 60 days before the renewal date for annual contracts. Failure to provide this notice invalidates automatic contract extension.

rules.statuteSummary: A consumer who enters into an automatic renewal contract online must be allowed to terminate the contract online without requiring a phone call or in-person visit.
rules.disputeTemplate: 815 ILCS 601/10(c) mandates that Illinois consumers who subscribe online must be permitted to cancel online without telephonic or physical hurdles.
